objective: Preserve CPVS candidate and published-table row-level evidence so duplicate rows and parser behavior cannot be hidden by set-only membership comparison.
previous_knowledge_consumed: CPVS reconstruction remains scientifically unresolved; prior heavy validation did not prove exact membership.
Set equality hides duplicate multiplicities and does not establish correctness of the scientific selection predicate.
The cumulative lifecycle CI requires a machine-readable cycle record for meaningful pull requests.

baseline.description: PR #184 adds row-preserving candidate/VizieR readers, duplicate summaries, parser mode, and row/unique-ID digests; scientific CPVS selection logic is unchanged.

expected_improvement: Expose candidate and published row counts and duplicate diagnostics.
Distinguish unique membership equality from row-multiset equality.
Keep CPVS reconstruction status unresolved until source-backed exact-membership and full-vs-batch evidence passes.

correctness.before: The set-only audit could conceal duplicate row multiplicity.
correctness.after: Audit report records row counts, unique counts, duplicate IDs/rows, parser mode, and SHA-256 digests.

scientific_validity.reason: Diagnostics-only change; no new full CPVS source-backed run has established exact membership.

evidence: Initial PR CI failed because the required cycle record was missing.
After adding the record, CI exposed an unsupported metric name; the cycle record is being corrected to match the repository lifecycle schema.
Format Check, Lint, CodeQL, and Scientific Validation contract workflow passed on the latest observed run, but full CI did not pass.

root_causes: The initial PR omitted the mandatory cumulative cycle record.
The first cycle record used an unsupported metric name, audit_observability, which the lifecycle contract rejects.
Previous set-only audit did not preserve duplicate row evidence.

findings: Process-level cycle records are required for every meaningful PR.
Cycle metric names must match the allowlist in src/ztf_classifier/lifecycle.py.
Membership equality and row-multiset equality are separate checks; neither proves the scientific predicate by itself.

open_blockers: PR CI must pass after correcting the cycle record.
Rerun heavy source-backed CPVS reconstruction and inspect membership_audit and selection diagnostics.
Exact membership and full-vs-batch equivalence remain release-blocking.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not introduce an unverified magnitude-zero filter or hardcoded ID exclusions.
Keep issues #170 and #180 open until source-backed acceptance criteria pass.
The immutable v0.2.0 scientific baseline remains unchanged.
